prompt: Which art dealership did Peter Arrell Browne Widener buy "Portrait of Elena Grimaldi Cattaneo" from in 1906?
answer: Peter Arrell Browne Widener acquired it through **M. Knoedler & Co.** However, the National Gallery of Art records the sale to Widener as occurring in **1908**; in December 1906 the painting was placed on joint account with **P. & D. Colnaghi**.
